content.comment_body: Hello, How many devices can simultaneously access the web page of a [product_name] device? Just to provide more context: I have set up a web page for a [product_name] that controls my air conditioning system. On this page, I can monitor room conditions and change set points. Everything works as expected – I can access it from a PC on the same network. But when I try connecting with a second PC, it's not possible. I suspect this might be due to a firewall setting; however, the first PC was already logged in to the [product_name] web page at the time. This prompts me to wonder: Is it possible for two or more PCs/devices to access the same web page of a [product_name] at once? Thank you

Hello everyone, After reviewing forum discussions, it appears that only a single device can connect to the [product_name] web page at any given time. Perhaps I misunderstood or miscommunicated my issue earlier. I'm also facing another challenge. My [product_name] is connected to my home router via an Ethernet cable. I can access the web page and successfully ping the [product_name] from my laptop, both through WiFi and Ethernet. But when I attempt to connect using a different laptop (by entering the [product_name] IP address), the page isn't found, and pinging the IP address also fails. I don't have much experience with networks and routers. I've read several forum posts mentioning port 8080, but I'm unclear if this setting affects the [product_name], the laptop, or the router. Are there basic instructions or guides available that could help someone new to these topics? Thanks in advance

analysis.insight_summary: Users are inquiring about whether multiple devices can access the web interface of a [product_name] device at the same time. The central points include connection limitations and challenges with network accessibility, raising concerns about device restrictions and possible configuration requirements. There's ongoing difficulty with connecting a second device, prompting further investigation into access limitations and the need for basic guidance on network settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to monitor and control their [product_name] device from multiple PCs at the same time using a web browser, and expects simple network configuration.
